singleTab.followerTitle: {{context}} is already open in another tab
singleTab.followerDescription: This tab does not load the desktop or call the API until it becomes the primary tab. If the active tab has a live channel open, it will ask for confirmation for up to 60 seconds.
singleTab.followerFootnote: Both tabs must use the same app address (for example app.eliteew.ru).
singleTab.handoffDescription: Confirmation was requested on the active EliteEW tab. If there is no reply within a minute, the request will be declined.
singleTab.handoffFootnote: You can wait here or close this tab — the primary tab keeps working.
